doc.name: G — 30s gaming tournament arc set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone, a family of three, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: gaming tournament arc set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone
Hero: a family of three
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the gaming tournament arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone form, built around a family of three.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. If a product or logo appears, its form and label must be identical in all three acts.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace in Act 1 against a whip pan that resolves onto the subject in Act 3 — while holding the a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second gaming tournament arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance, shot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/1.4, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second gaming tournament arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off, shot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/1.8, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second gaming tournament arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a snap zoom in followed by a settle, shot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/1.8, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts
